sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of brepocitinib during breastfeeding. Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in the breastfed infant, including infections, GI perforation, and malignancy, breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with brepocitinib and for 3 days after the last dose.
